section.content: 本发明公开了一种藻类生物基因用基因检测系统，涉及基因检测技术领域，一种藻类生物基因用基因检测系统，包括样本采集模块、特征提取模块、扩增模块、测序模块、分析模块以及报告模块，本系统通过样本采集模块的高效采样方法和特征提取模块的精细数据处理，确保了环境数据的准确性和全面性，其次，扩增模块和测序模块的高效基因处理和测序技术，提高了基因数据的灵敏度和准确性。最后，分析模块的整合计算方法和报告模块的可视化展示，使得基因异常检测更加精准和及时，便于用户做出科学的干预决，通过整合不同数据集，系统能够更全面地评估藻类生物的基因状态，相比单一数据集分析，能够提供更准确和全面的评估结果。

The invention discloses a gene detection system for algae biological genes, which relates to the technical field of gene detection, and comprises a sample acquisition module, a feature extraction module, an amplification module, a sequencing module, an analysis module and a reporting module, the system ensures the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the environmental data through the efficient sampling method of the sample acquisition module and the fine data processing of the feature extraction module, and secondly, the sensitivity and the accuracy of the gene data are improved through the efficient gene processing and sequencing technology of the amplification module and the sequencing module. Finally, the integrated calculation method of the analysis module and the visual display of the reporting module enable the gene abnormality detection to be more accurate and timely, facilitate the user to make scientific intervention decisions, enable the system to evaluate the gene states of the algae more comprehensively by integrating different data sets, and provide more accurate and comprehensive evaluation results compared with single data set analysis.

Gene detection system for algae organism genesTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a gene detection system for algae biological genes.

Background

In the monitoring and protection of water ecosystems, detection and assessment of algae biological genes is particularly important. The biomass, ecological function and genetic status of algae in water have profound effects on water quality assessment and environmental health.

In current management of water ecosystems, there are limitations of conventional genetic testing techniques. Traditional methods often rely on analysis of a single dataset, and it is difficult to comprehensively evaluate the complex status and environmental response of algae biological genes. In addition, the lack of quantitative genetic abnormality assessment methods, which makes subjectivity and uncertainty in assessing algae health and potential risk, limits the ability of decision makers to scientifically intervene and manage environmental problems.

The limitation causes the problems of misjudgment, missed detection and the like in the actual environment monitoring, and further can have adverse effects on the protection and repair of the water area ecological system. The lack of an accurate gene abnormality assessment method and flexibly adjusted analysis model parameters makes the existing system feel frustrated when dealing with environmental changes and diversity demands in different water areas. Therefore, in order to improve the scientificity and practicality of gene detection systems, it is highly desirable to introduce quantitative anomaly alarm coefficients and optimized weight adjustment mechanisms.

Disclosure of Invention

(One) solving the technical problems

In order to overcome the defects in the prior art, the invention provides a gene detection system for algae biological genes, which solves the problems in the background art.

(II) technical scheme

The invention is realized by the following technical scheme that the gene detection system for the algae biological genes comprises a sample acquisition module, a feature extraction module, an amplification module, a sequencing module, an analysis module and a reporting module;

The sample acquisition module is used for sampling the current water area, acquiring a plurality of groups of water area characteristic data and inputting the data into the characteristic extraction module;

the characteristic extraction module is used for processing a plurality of groups of water area characteristic data so as to generate a first data set, a second data set and a third data set;

the amplification module is used for carrying out DNA processing on the sample so as to obtain a fourth data set;

The analysis module is used for carrying out integrated calculation on the first data set, the second data set, the third data set and the fourth data set so as to generate a gene abnormality alarm coefficient, and comparing the gene abnormality alarm coefficient obtained by calculation with a preset first threshold Y to generate a comparison structure;

the report module is used for displaying the comparison result.

Preferably, the sample acquisition module comprises an environmental data acquisition unit, a physical data acquisition unit and a chemical data acquisition unit;

the environment data acquisition unit is used for acquiring data of the environment of the water area;

The physical data acquisition unit is used for acquiring physical data of the water area;

the chemical data acquisition unit is used for acquiring chemical data of the water area.

Preferably, the feature extraction module comprises a preprocessing unit and a sorting unit;

the preprocessing unit is used for preprocessing each item of data extracted by the sample acquisition module, and the finishing unit is used for reorganizing each item of preprocessed data into a first data set, a second data set and a third data set.

Preferably, the first dataset comprises water temperature SWD, pH PHZ and illumination intensity GZZ;

The second data set includes a sampling depth CYS, a water flow velocity SLS, and a suspended matter concentration XYW;

The third data set includes dissolved oxygen RJY, nitrogen concentration SND, and phosphorus concentration LND.

Preferably, the amplification module comprises a DNA extraction unit and a PCR compatibilization unit;

The DNA extraction unit is used for preprocessing the collected algae biological sample, removing impurities, crushing algae cells by using a physical, chemical or enzymatic method to release DNA, separating the DNA from cell lysate by centrifugation, filtration and washing, and purifying to remove protein and lipid impurities;

the PCR capacity-increasing unit is used for carrying out multiple rounds of PCR circulation and amplifying the target gene sequence.

Preferably, the sequencing module comprises a sequencing library construction unit and a high throughput sequencing unit;

The sequencing library construction unit is used for randomly cutting PCR amplified products or genomic DNA into fragments suitable for sequencing;

the high throughput sequencing unit is used for collecting raw data generated by sequencing to form a fourth data set.

Preferably, the fourth dataset comprises base pair frequencies BF, GC contents GC and sequence complexity SC.

Wherein SWD is water temperature, PHZ is pH value, GZZ is illumination intensity, CYS is sampling depth, SLS is water flow speed, XYW is suspended matter concentration, RJY is dissolved oxygen, SND is nitrogen concentration, LND is phosphorus concentration, BF is base pair frequency, GC is GC content, SC is Z is standardized coefficient, b1, b2, b3, c1, c2, c3, d1, d2, d3, e1, e2 and e3 are weight values, and values of Z, b1, b2, b3, c1, c2, c3, d1, d2, d3, e1, e2 and e3 are set by a user.

Preferably, the first comparison results are as follows;

When YJB is less than or equal to Y, representing that the current algae organism gene is not abnormal;

when YJB > Y, representing that the current algae biological gene is abnormal;

Wherein YJB is an anomaly alarm coefficient, and Y is a first threshold.

(III) beneficial effects

The invention provides a gene detection system for algae biological genes, which has the following beneficial effects:

1. According to the gene detection system for the algae biological genes, the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of environmental data are ensured through the efficient sampling method of the sample acquisition module and the fine data processing of the feature extraction module. And secondly, the high-efficiency gene processing and sequencing technology of the amplification module and the sequencing module improves the sensitivity and accuracy of the gene data. Finally, the integrated calculation method of the analysis module and the visual display of the reporting module enable the gene abnormality detection to be more accurate and timely, and facilitate the user to make scientific intervention decisions.

2. According to the gene detection system for the algae organism genes, different data sets are integrated, the system can evaluate the gene states of algae organisms more comprehensively, compared with single data set analysis, more accurate and comprehensive evaluation results can be provided, YJB is used as an abnormality alarm coefficient, a quantitative index is provided, the possibility of gene abnormality in a sample can be evaluated quantitatively, the quantitative output is helpful for a user to quickly understand the health condition and potential risk of the sample, scientific basis is provided for subsequent decision, the adjustability of the weight value enables the user to adjust an analysis model according to specific requirements and preference, the flexibility and applicability of the system are enhanced, and different users can adjust weights according to focus of attention of the user to meet specific research or application requirements.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic flow chart of the system of the present invention.

In the figure, 1, a sample acquisition module; the device comprises an environment data acquisition unit, a physical data acquisition unit, a chemical data acquisition unit, a characteristic extraction module, a preprocessing unit, a sorting unit, an amplification module, a DNA extraction unit, a PCR capacity-increasing unit, a sequencing module, a sequencing library construction unit, a high-throughput sequencing unit, a 5-analysis module, a 6-reporting module, wherein the environment data acquisition unit, the physical data acquisition unit, the chemical data acquisition unit, the characteristic extraction module, the preprocessing unit, the 22-finishing unit, the amplification module, the DNA extraction unit, the PCR capacity-increasing unit, the sequencing module, the sequencing library construction unit, the high-throughput sequencing unit, the 5-analysis module and the reporting module.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present invention will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present invention, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the invention without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the invention.

Example 1

Referring to fig. 1, a gene detection system for algae biological genes includes a sample collection module 1, a feature extraction module 2, an amplification module 3, a sequencing module 4, an analysis module 5, and a reporting module 6;

the sample acquisition module 1 is used for sampling a current water area, acquiring a plurality of groups of water area characteristic data, and inputting the water area characteristic data into the characteristic extraction module 2;

The feature extraction module 2 is used for processing a plurality of groups of water area feature data so as to generate a first data set, a second data set and a third data set;

The amplification module 3 is used for performing DNA processing on the sample so as to obtain a fourth data set;

The analysis module 5 is used for carrying out integration calculation on the first data set, the second data set, the third data set and the fourth data set so as to generate a gene abnormality alarm coefficient, and comparing the gene abnormality alarm coefficient obtained by calculation with a preset first threshold Y to generate a comparison structure;

The reporting module 6 is used for displaying the comparison result.

In the embodiment, the sample acquisition module 1 is used for sampling the current water area to obtain a plurality of groups of water area characteristic data including water temperature, pH value, illumination intensity and the like. These data are the basis for analysis of the algae growth environment, providing the necessary background information for subsequent genetic testing. By the efficient sampling method, accuracy and comprehensiveness of data are ensured, so that reliability and precision of the whole gene detection system are improved.

The feature extraction module 2 is used for processing a plurality of groups of water area feature data to generate a first data set, a second data set and a third data set. The module can classify and normalize complex raw data, and extract useful information such as change modes of water temperature, fluctuation range of pH value and daily change curve of illumination intensity. Through the processing, the feature extraction module can effectively simplify data and reserve key information, thereby laying a foundation for subsequent analysis

Amplification module 3 the amplification module is used for DNA processing of the collected sample, thereby obtaining a fourth data set. The module adopts the PCR polymerase chain reaction and other gene amplification technologies, can amplify a large amount of trace DNA samples in a short time, and ensures that the sample size is enough to carry out subsequent gene sequencing and analysis. Through efficient amplification technology, the sensitivity and accuracy of gene detection are ensured.

Sequencing module 4 the sequencing module is used for carrying out gene sequencing to the amplified DNA sample, obtains detailed gene sequence information. This module enables rapid and accurate reading of DNA sequences using high throughput sequencing techniques, generating a fourth dataset comprising millions of base pairs. Through high-precision sequencing technology, the integrity and the accuracy of gene information are ensured, and a solid data base is provided for subsequent gene analysis.

The analysis module 5 is used for carrying out integrated calculation on the first data set, the second data set, the third data set and the fourth data set, so as to generate a gene abnormality alarm coefficient, and comparing a calculation result with a preset first threshold value Y to generate a comparison result. By comprehensively considering the environmental data and the genetic data, the analysis module can identify potential genetic abnormality and environmental change, and provides basis for early warning and intervention. The integrated calculation method of the module improves the accuracy and timeliness of anomaly detection.

The reporting module 6 is used for displaying the comparison result, and displaying the result of comparing the gene abnormality alarm coefficient generated by the analysis module with the preset threshold value to the user in an intuitive manner. Through detailed reports, users can quickly know the genetic status and potential abnormal risks of algae in the current water area, so that corresponding measures can be taken. The report function of the module improves the visualization and the readability of the information, and is convenient for the user to make scientific decisions.

The system ensures the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the environmental data through the efficient sampling method of the sample acquisition module and the fine data processing of the feature extraction module. And secondly, the high-efficiency gene processing and sequencing technology of the amplification module and the sequencing module improves the sensitivity and accuracy of the gene data. Finally, the integrated calculation method of the analysis module and the visual display of the reporting module enable the gene abnormality detection to be more accurate and timely, and facilitate the user to make scientific intervention decisions.

Example 2

Referring to fig. 1, a sample collection module 1 includes an environmental data collection unit 11, a physical data collection unit 12, and a chemical data collection unit 13;

The environment data acquisition unit 11 is used for acquiring data of the environment of the water area;

the physical data acquisition unit 12 is used for acquiring physical data of a water area;

The chemical data acquisition unit 13 is used for acquiring chemical data of the water area.

In the embodiment, the system realizes multi-dimensional data acquisition and classification management by subdividing the sample acquisition module 1 into the environmental data acquisition unit 11, the physical data acquisition unit 12 and the chemical data acquisition unit 13, and compared with the traditional method, the system has the advantage of remarkably improving the comprehensiveness, the detection precision and the flexibility of data acquisition. The modularized design not only enables the system to be more flexibly adapted under various application scenes, but also enhances the capacity of comprehensive utilization of data, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of gene abnormality detection.

Example 3

Referring to fig. 1, a feature extraction module 2 includes a preprocessing unit 21 and a sorting unit 22;

The preprocessing unit 21 is configured to preprocess each item of data extracted by the sample collection module 1, and the sorting unit 22 is configured to reorganize each item of preprocessed data into a first data set, a second data set, and a third data set.

In the embodiment, the preprocessing unit 21 cleans and denoises the collected original data, so that impurities and abnormal values in the data are eliminated, and the accuracy and reliability of the data are improved.

The sorting unit 22 reorganizes the preprocessed data into a structured first data set, a second data set, and a third data set, making the data more ordered and canonical

The system realizes comprehensive preprocessing and effective recombination of the acquired data by subdividing the feature extraction module 2 into the preprocessing unit 21 and the arrangement unit 22. Compared with the traditional method, the system has the advantages of remarkably improving the data quality, the management efficiency and the analysis basis. The preprocessing unit cleans and denoises the data, ensures the accuracy of the data, and the finishing unit reorganizes the data into a structured data set, so that the data management is more orderly and standard. The modularized design improves the processing efficiency and the fineness of the system, and provides high-quality basic data for subsequent gene detection and analysis.

Example 4

Referring to fig. 1, the first data set includes a water temperature SWD, a PH value PHZ, and an illumination intensity GZZ;

The second data set includes a sampling depth CYS, a water flow velocity SLS, and a suspended matter concentration XYW;

The third data set includes dissolved oxygen RJY, nitrogen concentration SND, and phosphorus concentration LND.

In the embodiment, the environmental parameters such as water temperature, pH value, illumination intensity and the like in the first data set can reflect the basic environmental condition of a water area, the sampling depth, water flow speed and suspended matter concentration in the second data set cover physical characteristics, and the dissolved oxygen, nitrogen concentration and phosphorus concentration in the third data set relate to chemical components. Through the integration of the three types of data, the system can comprehensively monitor the overall condition of a water area, structured data classification enables various data to be more orderly and normative in the process of collection and processing, reduces data redundancy and errors, improves the accuracy of detection results, simplifies the data management flow through clear data classification and structured storage, enables the system to rapidly and effectively process and analyze a large amount of complex data, and improves the overall efficiency.

Example 5

Referring to fig. 1, the amplification module 3 includes a DNA extraction unit 31 and a PCR compatibilization unit 32;

The DNA extraction unit 31 is used for pre-treating the collected algal biological sample to remove impurities, breaking up algal cells using physical, chemical or enzymatic methods to release DNA, separating DNA from cell lysate by centrifugation, filtration, washing, and purifying to remove protein and lipid impurities;

the PCR-compatible unit 32 is used to perform multiple PCR cycles to amplify the target gene sequence.

In this embodiment, the DNA extraction unit 31 is capable of removing protein and lipid impurities from the cell lysate by comprehensive physical, chemical and enzymatic disruption methods and multi-step purification such as centrifugation, filtration and washing to obtain high-purity DNA, which provides a high-quality base material for subsequent gene amplification and sequencing.

The PCR capacity-increasing unit 32 accurately amplifies the target gene sequence through multiple cycles, improves the concentration of the target gene, ensures the specificity and accuracy of amplification, and provides sufficient gene fragments for gene detection.

The amplification module realizes the functions of high-efficiency DNA extraction and accurate gene amplification by introducing a DNA extraction unit 31 and a PCR capacity-increasing unit 32. Compared with the traditional method, the system has obvious improvement in the aspects of purity of DNA extraction, accuracy of gene amplification and efficiency of a treatment process. Through high-quality DNA extraction, a pure DNA sample is ensured, and the concentration and the specificity of a target gene are improved through accurate PCR amplification. The optimized sub-step treatment process reduces operation errors and pollution risks.

Example 6

Referring to fig. 1, sequencing module 4 includes a sequencing library construction unit 41 and a high throughput sequencing unit 42;

the sequencing library construction unit 41 is used to randomly cut the PCR amplification products or genomic DNA into fragments suitable for sequencing;

the high throughput sequencing unit 42 is used to collect raw data generated by sequencing to construct a fourth dataset.

In this embodiment, the sequencing library construction unit 41 uses a random shearing technique to cut the PCR amplification product or genomic DNA into fragments suitable for sequencing, ensuring the representativeness and comprehensiveness of the sample during the sequencing process.

The high throughput sequencing unit 42 is capable of rapidly and efficiently collecting large amounts of sequencing data, improving the speed of data acquisition and coverage, and providing adequate raw data support for subsequent analysis.

The introduction of the sequencing module 4 significantly improves the performance of the system in terms of sequencing quality and data processing efficiency. Accurate library construction ensures sample quality and representativeness, while high throughput sequencing units provide a reliable basis for data analysis and conclusion of the system through rapid and efficient data collection.

The fourth dataset included base pair frequency BF, GC content GC and sequence complexity SC.

In the embodiment, the water quality conditions in different stages or environmental conditions in the algae biological gene detection system can be comprehensively evaluated by integrating the first to fourth data sets of the plurality of data sets and calculating the first stage value S1, the second stage value S2 and the third stage value S3. Compared with single data set analysis, the comprehensive evaluation can more accurately capture the change trend and systematic influence, and helps researchers to comprehensively understand the health state of an ecological system.

The calculation of each stage value involves a plurality of key factors such as water temperature, PH value, illumination intensity, dissolved oxygen, nitrogen and phosphorus concentration and the like, and through the adjustment of weight values b1, b2, b3, c1, c2, c3, d1, d2, d3, e1, e2 and e3, a user can reasonably balance the influence degree of each factor according to specific environmental conditions and research emphasis, so that the pertinence and the practicability of an analysis result are improved.

The introduction of the standardized coefficient JRZ ensures that the calculation results of the different stage values S1, S2 and S3 have consistency and comparability, eliminates the evaluation deviation caused by the data magnitude difference, and ensures that the analysis result has more scientific reliability.

The adjustability of all parameters, such as the weight value and the setting of the standardization coefficient Z, enables the analysis module to be customized in a personalized way according to the requirements of users and specific research scenes. The user can flexibly adjust algorithm parameters according to actual conditions so as to adapt to different environment monitoring and scientific research requirements, and the applicability and practicality of the system are improved.

The analysis module 5 integrates information from multiple data sets, including environmental data and genetic profile data. By integrating different data sets, the system can evaluate the genetic status of algae more comprehensively, and can provide more accurate and comprehensive evaluation results compared with single data set analysis, YJB is used as an abnormality alarm coefficient, a quantitative index is provided, and the possibility of genetic abnormality in a sample can be evaluated quantitatively. The quantitative output is beneficial to the user to quickly know the health condition and potential risk of the sample, scientific basis is provided for subsequent decision making, and the adjustability of the weight value enables the user to adjust the analysis model according to specific requirements and preferences, so that the flexibility and applicability of the system are enhanced. Different users can adjust the weights according to the focus of their attention to meet their specific research or application needs.

The first comparison result is as follows;

When YJB is less than or equal to Y, representing that the current algae organism gene is not abnormal;

when YJB > Y, representing that the current algae biological gene is abnormal;

Wherein YJB is an anomaly alarm coefficient, and Y is a first threshold.
